name: Kardur, Doomscourge
oracle_text:
When Kardur enters, until your next turn, creatures your opponents control attack each combat if able and attack a player other than you if able.
Whenever an attacking creature dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
blocked_sentences: When Kardur enters, until your next turn, creatures your opponents control attack each combat if able and attack a player other than you if able.

needs.what: a one-shot effect giving the creatures matched at resolution goad's two requirements (attack each combat if able; attack a player other than the effect's controller if able) until the controller's next turn, WITHOUT marking them goaded -- e.g. a `goad` option like `mark_goaded: false`, so `goaded` filters (Vengeful Ancestor, Puppet Master's treasure trigger) do not see them
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `goad` gives exactly these requirements but also makes the creatures goaded, which Kardur's ruling says it does not (an observable difference for every `goaded` filter); `must_attack` compels one combat only and has no defender restriction; `must_attack_player` names one required defender rather than forbidding the controller; `cant_attack_player` is a prohibition, not an 'if able' preference; the `attacks_if_able` static lives on Kardur, ends when it leaves, and cannot end at your next turn
